title: Grouped-comparator tuning tool (diagnostic only)
invariant: D1 produces the grouped tuned baseline comparator, which is diagnostic only and never deployable through V3. Its receipt digest (or 'groupedComparator: unavailable') is consumed at the section 6.5 E3_INPUT_SEAL barrier: if a valid D1 receipt exists at that barrier, E3 must consume it even when the comparator is optional; a material grouped win yields terminal 'learned_not_justified'. A late D1 receipt is diagnostic only and cannot retroactively change selection. Tuning must be reproducible with the sealed grid seed and tiebreak (section 7.6 RED row: search_is_reproducible_with_sealed_grid_seed_and_tiebreak).

title: Mode-neutral residual trainer (ResidualModelV1)
